report_title: SporeKart Enterprise Mobile Experience Validation Report

issues: Tables may overflow on some pages
KPI grid collapses to single column
Foldable simulation not configured in Playwright

breakpoint_system.details: CSS breakpoints and React context breakpoints do not align. CSS --bp-xs uses 480px. React context defines xs as 0-479px. Gap at 480-639px range.

grid_layout.details: Grid component uses auto-fit/auto-fill with minColumnWidth. Fluid behavior works at all viewports.

cards.details: EnterpriseOrderCard, dashboard cards adapt to viewport via Grid component.

tables.details: No horizontal scroll wrapper on admin tables. Content overflows on viewports below 480px.

buttons.details: Profile action buttons overlap at 375px and below. Hamburger button is 36x36px (below 44x44 WCAG minimum).

forms.details: Auth forms use max-width 440px and adapt via auth.css responsive styles. Mobile brand logo appears below 900px.

navigation.details: Sidebar overlay may persist after navigation on mobile. Hamburger below touch target minimum.

images.details: Images not found to overflow in the codebase.

typography.details: Uses clamp() for fluid typography. Clear hierarchy maintained at all viewports.

spacing.details: Semantic spacing variables with clamp() ensure proportional spacing at all viewports.

overflow.details: Admin tables overflow without scrollbars at mobile viewports.

tap.details: All buttons/have onClick handlers or TouchableOpacity wrappers

double_tap.details: No double-tap handlers found. Verify zoom behavior in iOS Safari.

long_press.details: No long-press handlers found for context menus, copy, or drag operations.

swipe.details: No swipe-to-delete or swipe-to-navigate gestures found. Sidebar does not support swipe-to-open.

scroll.details: ScrollView used in mobile apps. Default browser scrolling in web-app.

momentum_scroll.details: Default momentum scroll in web-app. ScrollView provides inertial scrolling in mobile apps.

touch_targets.details: Hamburger menu button is ~36x36px (needs 44x44). Close buttons may be undersized.

touch_accuracy.details: Data entry buttons in tables may be too close together. Not enough padding on small action icons.

button_size.details: Icon buttons in header (action, notification, AI assistant) lack explicit min-width/min-height for touch.

custom_gesture_support.details: ResizableDrawer is the only component with custom touch/gesture handling. All other components lack gesture support.

portrait.details: All pages render in portrait mode

landscape.details: No landscape-specific CSS or components found

orientation_change.details: No orientation change handlers found in web-app. Mobile apps have no orientation configuration.

state_preservation.details: No state preservation logic found for orientation changes

keyboard_open.details: No KeyboardAvoidingView in mobile apps. No scroll-into-view behavior for focused inputs in web-app.

keyboard_close.details: Escape key handlers in modals, dialogs, drawers, popovers.

input_focus.details: RegisterPage uses useRef + focus() for first error field. Auth forms manage focus properly.

auto_scroll.details: No auto-scroll behavior when keyboard appears on web-app. No KeyboardAvoidingView in mobile apps.

password_field.details: Password fields use appropriate input types. Forgot password flow present.

email_field.details: Email fields use email input type with validation.

phone_field.details: Phone fields use tel input type with validation.

otp_field.details: OtpInput component supports 6-digit code. Keyboard type number-pad in mobile app.

address_field.details: No address forms found in codebase yet.

search_field.details: Search input in OrdersDashboard. Command palette search trigger.

fast_4g.details: Network throttling not implemented in static analysis

slow_4g.details: Network throttling not implemented in static analysis

3g.details: Network throttling not implemented in static analysis

offline.details: Offline service exists in mobile-core (OfflineSyncService.ts) but no usage found in screens. No offline fallback in web-app.

high_latency.details: High latency testing requires runtime execution

layout_shift.details: ShimmerLoader used for loading states. No CLS measurement available. Auth success screen may cause layout shift.

scroll_performance.details: FlatList with numColumns=2 in mobile BrowseScreen. Virtualized list pattern is correct.

animation_smoothness.details: ResponsiveModal/ResponsiveDialog use CSS animations. Mobile bottom-sheet animation may jank on low-end devices. prefers-reduced-motion honored.

screen_reader.details: aria-label and aria-labelledby used extensively. Some icon-only buttons lack labels.

keyboard_navigation.details: Skip-to-content link exists. Tab order follows logical flow. Escape handlers in modals. focus-visible styling applied.

contrast.details: Design tokens use accessible contrast ratios. Dark theme support.

zoom_200.details: Auth shell uses clamp() which scales. But sidebar width is fixed 264px. Tables may break at 200% zoom.

zoom_400.details: Not tested, expected to fail given fixed-width layouts and no zoom-specific styles.

touch_accessibility.details: Touch targets below 44x44px. Insufficient spacing between icon buttons.

focusable_elements.details: Interactive elements are focusable. Tab order is logical.

aria.details: ARIA attributes used: role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-selected, aria-checked, aria-live.

visual_regression.notes: Playwright config has screenshot: 'on' but visual regression testing with baseline comparison is not configured. No snapshot test files found.

session_after_rotation.details: Requires runtime testing on real device

session_after_background.details: Token refresh interceptor in ApiClient.ts (mobile-core). Zustand auth store persists state.

session_after_foreground.details: Requires runtime testing on real device

auto_fill.details: autoComplete attributes set on forms (tel, email, etc.)

clipboard.details: OTP input does not prevent clipboard paste. Sensitive data could be copied from OTP display.

sensitive_information.details: OTP masked in UI. Phone numbers partially masked (shows last 4 digits).

bugs.title: Admin KPI grid collapses to single column
Admin tables overflow viewport without horizontal scroll
Profile action buttons overlap on small mobile
Sidebar overlay persists after navigation on mobile
Mobile checkout unusable: no responsive cart or payment flow
ResponsiveModal shows desktop variant on some mobile viewports
CSS breakpoint system mismatch with React breakpoint context
No KeyboardAvoidingView in mobile apps - keyboard may overlap inputs
No orientation handling in mobile apps or web-app
Swipe gestures not supported - sidebar, card dismiss missing
Mobile apps in Phase 0 - placeholder screens only
Admin Companion app has zero source files

recommendations: Add horizontal scroll wrapper with overflow-x: auto to all admin tables
Increase hamburger menu button to min 44x44px (WCAG touch target)
Add flex-wrap: wrap to profile action buttons container
Fix sidebar overlay race condition: close drawer immediately before navigation
Align CSS --bp-xs with React breakpoint context (set --bp-xs: 640px or update context)
Initialize ResponsiveModal/ResponsiveDialog isMobile with window.innerWidth <= 767 fallback
Add KeyboardAvoidingView to mobile app screens
Configure Landscape orientation support in mobile apps
Add swipe-to-close gesture for mobile sidebar
Add long-press context menu for product cards and orders
Implement responsive checkout page for mobile viewports
Add WebKit/Safari and Edge to Playwright browser projects
Create snapshot baseline for visual regression testing
Add foldable viewport (280px) to Playwright devices
Build out mobile app screens from Phase 0 to Phase 1 for Customer, Dealer, Grower, and Admin Companion apps
Prevent clipboard paste on OTP input fields
